spans.s:
मज्ज् म॑ज्जति (म॑ज्ज˚ते), pp. मग्न (q.v.) sink (in
water), dive, bathe, be submerged or drowned, be ruined, perish. C.
मज्ज॑यति (˚ते) = S. trans. or act. — उद् emerge or plunge. C.
cause to emerge or come up. उप sink, dive. नि sink down, plunge or
penetrate into (loc.);
 disappear, perish;
 cause to sink or fall. C.
cause to dive, drown. संनि sink down, fall. निस् sink;
 overflow.
प्र & वि plunge, rush into (acc. or loc.). — Cf. आमग्न, उन्मग्न,
निमग्न, संमग्न.
मज्जन n. sinking, diving, bathing, overflowing.
